calculation.description: Reverse each asset's three-session cross-sectional relative return, activated smoothly when the fraction of tradable assets with negative five-session returns exceeds 50 percent and reaching full strength at 75 percent downside breadth. All inputs are lagged or completed at the signal date.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC/ICIR: 2020-2022 +0.0162602/+0.0449935 (63 dates), 2023-2024 +0.0437040/+0.1196643 (33 dates), 2025-2027 +0.0524626/+0.1658903 (38 dates). Five-day decay is based on only 9 valid dates and is highly uncertain.

notes: All 15 tradable benchmark instruments were used; observation-only macro symbols were excluded. Daily IC observations require at least 8 valid instruments. Deterministic library-correlation audit remains pending.
